run_gtest_skip_test: run the gtest skip test binary and capture its output for verification
test_skip_entire_environment: test that gtest skip messages appear correctly in the test output
verify_skip_output_no_failures: verify the test output contains skip messages but no FAILED status
get_test_executable_path: get the path to the gtest_skip_test executable using gtest_test_utils
subprocess_run_test_binary: run a test binary via subprocess and capture its stdout output
